subject: HIPAA BAA availability and PHI-handling for evaluation POC
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Simmons <kate@medassist.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + security asks (HIPAA/BAA)

Hi Kate — great to speak earlier. Thanks for the demo walk-through and for outlining where MedAssist wants to validate: a small evaluation POC that will process patient intake forms for triage ML models. Quick recap and asks so we can move to SOW: 

Summary from our call:
- POC scope: ~2k records, ingestion -> embeddings -> reranking for triage suggestions.
- Success criteria: under 200ms per request tail and model output fidelity on your test prompts.
- Timeline: aim to start environment provisioning the week of Oct 11, 2-week POC.

Security/compliance items we need clarified to finalize a minimal SOW: 
1) SOC 2 status: do you have SOC 2 Type II reports, or an expected completion date?
2) BAA: is MedAssist able to execute a vendor BAA? If yes, any standard edits we should expect?
3) PHI boundaries: can you confirm whether the PII/PHI we'll process will include identifiers (SSN/DOB) vs tokenized clinical notes only? This affects deployment mode recommendation.
4) Preferred hosting for POC: Hosted (Redwood managed), Dedicated (reserved GPUs) or Private (VPC/on-prem)? Please state any restrictions (e.g., must be in customer VPC).
5) Security questionnaire: I attached our short vendor questionnaire — can you route to your security/compliance lead? If easier, feel free to return your security questionnaire and we'll fill in the infrastructure specifics.

Attachments: [attachment: Redwood_POC_questionnaire_short.pdf] (sent inline).

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm SOC2/BAA stance and PHI boundary by EOD Tue Oct 5.
- We deliver a POC SOW draft (attached) for review by Oct 6.
- Schedule a 30-min scoping call with your security contact to confirm logging/KMS/region.

Thanks — looping Neha (solutions/security) and Marissa (CS lead) to help with technical scope and the SOW.

Best,

Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priom@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Kate Simmons <kate@medassist.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Adler <tom.adler@medassist.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + security asks (HIPAA/BAA)

Thanks, Priyom — great summary. Quick answers and a few items from our side: 

1) SOC 2: We are SOC 2 Type I compliant today and have Type II in progress; expected completion Q1 2028.
2) BAA: Yes, we can sign a BAA. Our legal team typically requests two small edits (limiting liability and data return timeline). Happy to review Redwood's standard BAA.
3) PHI boundaries for the POC: We will provide tokenized intake forms and de-identified notes for the first phase. For phase 2 we may want to test identifiers included for matching (DOB + MRN) but only if the environment is in a dedicated or private deployment.
4) Hosting preference: For the POC, we'd prefer Dedicated (reserved capacity) in AWS us-west-2. Final decision depends on encryption/KMS and access to audit logs.
5) Security questionnaire: Attached our completed questionnaire (we included a more detailed internal security contact).

Attachment: [attachment: MedAssist_Security_Questionnaire.pdf]

Next steps on our side: Tom (cc'd) will handle the security call scheduling. Legal will start a review of the BAA once we have your standard template. Please send the SOW draft and any KMS/region statements so Tom can validate.

Thanks,

Kate Simmons
Head of Product | MedAssist.ai
kate@medassist.ai | +1 (206) 555-0117

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Simmons <kate@medassist.ai>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + security asks (HIPAA/BAA)

Kate — perfect, really helpful. Attaching an initial POC SOW and a short note on our default technical controls. High-level replies inline below and actions at the bottom.

Inline: 
- SOC2: understood — we can operate with Type I in place for the POC; for production we'll need Type II or equivalent assurances (we can add a milestone in the SOW).
- BAA: we'll send our standard BAA text via DocuSign and mention common redline positions up front (liability cap and data return windows).
- PHI: good plan to start with de-identified data. For the phase that includes identifiers, we will recommend either Dedicated or Private and require KMS control and restricted KV-cache persistence settings.
- Hosting: we can provision Dedicated capacity in us-west-2. Our default for Dedicated includes: encrypted at rest (AES-256), BYOK/KMS integration options, and audit logging with 90-day retention; we can extend retention as a paid option.

Attached: [attachment: POC_SOW_draft.docx] — SOW includes: success criteria, estimated costs for 2-week POC on Dedicated nodes, and a security appendix describing KMS options, KV cache retention, and logging hooks.

Requested confirmations from your side: 
- Confirm us-west-2 as the required region.
- Confirm whether phase 2 (identifiers present) will need Redwood-managed KMS or your customer-managed KMS (BYOK).
- Please provide a security contact availability window (Tom, if you can share 30–45 min windows next week we’ll book).

If those are confirmed, I’ll create a short DocuSign BAA package and send over a finalized SOW for signatures.

Thanks — cc'ing Neha and Marissa to own the technical scoping and SOW follow-up.

Best,

Priyom

From: Tom Adler <tom.adler@medassist.ai>

Please confirm and include any short agenda points (KMS, audit logs, region SLAs). Also we require a written guarantee that Dedicated capacity will be pinned to us-west-2 for the POC window.
